import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INV = 570000004;
    static Map<BitSet128, Integer> indexMap = new HashMap<>();
    static int nodeCount, timestamp;
    static int[][] children;
    static int[][] p = new int[7][7];
    static int[][] q = new int[7][128];
    static int[][] dp = new int[8][65536];

    static class BitSet128 {
        long[] bits = new long[2];

        public BitSet128() {
            bits[0] = 0;
            bits[1] = 0;
        }

        public BitSet128(long high, long low) {
            bits[0] = low;
            bits[1] = high;
        }

        public boolean get(int index) {
            if (index < 64) {
                return ((bits[0] >>> index) & 1L) != 0;
            } else {
                return ((bits[1] >>> (index - 64)) & 1L) != 0;
            }
        }

        public void set(int index) {
            if (index < 64) {
                bits[0] |= 1L << index;
            } else {
                bits[1] |= 1L << (index - 64);
            }
        }

        public void clear() {
            bits[0] = 0;
            bits[1] = 0;
        }

        public BitSet128 clone() {
            return new BitSet128(bits[1], bits[0]);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof BitSet128)) return false;
            BitSet128 that = (BitSet128) o;
            return bits[0] == that.bits[0] && bits[1] == that.bits[1];
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(bits[0], bits[1]);
        }
    }

    static int addMod(int a, int b) {
        int s = a + b;
        return s >= MOD ? s - MOD : s;
    }

    static int subMod(int a, int b) {
        int s = a - b;
        return s < 0 ? s + MOD : s;
    }

    static int mulMod(int a, int b) {
        return (int) ((1L * a * b) % MOD);
    }

    static int dfs(BitSet128 state) {
        if (indexMap.containsKey(state))
            return indexMap.get(state);
        int currentId = timestamp++;
        indexMap.put(state, currentId);
        children[currentId] = new int[1 << nodeCount];
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << nodeCount); ++mask) {
            BitSet128 newState = new BitSet128();
            newState.clear();
            for (int j = 0; j < nodeCount; ++j) {
                if (!state.get(j)) {
                    int kMask = mask & (1 << j);
                    int kTemp = kMask;
                    while (kTemp != 0) {
                        int kBit = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(kTemp);
                        int jXor = j ^ (1 << kBit);
                        if (state.get(jXor)) {
                            newState.set(j);
                            break;
                        }
                        kTemp &= ~(1 << kBit);
                    }
                }
            }
            children[currentId][mask] = dfs(newState);
        }
        return currentId;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        nodeCount = n;
        timestamp = 0;
        indexMap.clear();

        // Initialize children array with size 65536
        children = new int[65536][];
        // Run initial DFS with state = 1 (bitset with first bit set)
        BitSet128 initialState = new BitSet128();
        initialState.set(0);
        dfs(initialState);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                p[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = mulMod(p[i][j], INV);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); ++j) {
                q[i][j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                    int val = ((j >> k) & 1) != 0 ? p[k][i] : subMod(1, p[k][i]);
                    q[i][j] = mulMod(q[i][j], val);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], 0);
        dp[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < timestamp; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < (1 << n); ++k) {
                    int nextState = children[j][k];
                    dp[i + 1][nextState] = addMod(dp[i + 1][nextState], mulMod(dp[i][j], q[i][k]));
                }
            }
        }

        BitSet128 res = new BitSet128();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
            res.set(i);
        }

        Integer result = dp[n][indexMap.get(res)];
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
